harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied live, and verified survival across a full node restart with a changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl state and boot_id on node1
Checked existing sysctl.d files to avoid conflicts with 50-default.conf
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for both all and default IPv4 conf scopes
Applied via `sysctl --system` and verified live values changed to 0
Explicitly set the existing enp1s0 interface's accept_redirects to 0 for immediate consistency (persistence already guaranteed via conf.default inheritance)
Triggered a native reboot on node1 (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnection)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (4999270d... -> e47b353b...), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-reboot that all/default accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route are 0, and that enp1s0 (the real interface) shows accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0
Confirmed the persistent config file /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf survived the reboot unchanged

evidence.requirement: Baseline captured before change (pre-hardening sysctl values and boot identity)
evidence.summary: Showed accept_redirects=1 (needed change) and accept_source_route=0 already; captured original boot_id 4999270d-9a49-492a-8d7f-5b6fb938b7e9

evidence.requirement: Persistent config created and applied for ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance disable
evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied with sysctl --system, and confirmed live values (all/default accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route) are 0; also set enp1s0 interface explicitly to 0

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and boot identity change
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show connection timeout/reset during reboot, then successful reconnection with a new boot_id (e47b353b-c3ac-4b50-8850-d2e43af95ce8) proving the node actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery verification of the hardening setting
evidence.summary: After reboot, all/default accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 confirmed live, interface enp1s0 also shows 0 for both settings, and the /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf file is intact, proving persistence across restart
